title: Pan-Seared Brazilian Green Beans with Crispy Savory Crust
description: A French-inspired side dish featuring pan-seared green beans with a crunchy, savory crust.
instructions: Heat olive oil in a large skillet over medium-high heat.
Add the chopped onion and cook until crispy, about 3-4 minutes.
Add the green beans to the skillet and cook for 4-5 minutes, or until tender.
Sprinkle the savory breadcrumbs over the green beans and cook for an additional 1-2 minutes.
Season with salt, black pepper, and garlic powder to taste.
